dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: I spoke to my crew. All Blazing Beasts are fully all on board with the idea.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Any commissions we receive for the region west of the Hypostyle Desert, north of the Desert of Hadramaveth, east of Ardravi Valley, and south of the Ashavan Realm are yours!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: We haven't had many lately, but in the past, we've usually gotten a few good ones every year.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The pay's insane, but so are the risks. The type of work that normally calls for a team of heavily armed mercs.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: But this should be just right for you. If it were any easier, you might not even break a sweat!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're so quick, Dehya! Everyone agreed, just like that. Guess that means we're now official partners of the Blazing Beasts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hooah! Watch out world, there's a couple of new mercs on the scene! ...Maybe Paimon should give herself a proper mercenary name?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Haha, and when you're working in other nations, don't forget to give the Blazing Beasts a little plug now and then:

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Anyway, I'll send a letter to the Adventurers' Guild in various places when a job comes up. Make sure you check your mail!
